verdicts.reason: A scatters the content in fragments: the tagline and 'Solstice Presents' are crammed inside the decorative circle, the date and time sit in awkward side-by-side columns, and the badges are stacked down the right with large uneven gaps. The bottom half is mostly dead space around an oversized product can. Still, it keeps the logo, headline, details, CTA order and the RSVP button stands out. B's reading order is inverted: the RSVP CTA is shrunk to a badge-sized pill and jammed with the badges into the top-left corner on the circle, and 'Solstice Presents' ends up below its own headline. The text block below the headline is stacked with no spacing and mixes left and centred alignment, and the subtitle runs almost edge to edge, so B is the worse resize.
